description:
A rare Encino gem that perfectly blends modern design and income potential. Spanning approximately 1,938 sq ft in the main residence featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus a 480 sq ft two-story ADU with a loft, this exceptional property delivers both style and versatility in one of Encino’s most convenient locations.
From the moment you arrive, the curb appeal captivates with lush turf landscaping and custom brown exterior wall panels that add warmth, texture, and undeniable character.
Inside, every detail has been curated with intention. The main home features  2 bedrooms and 2  bathrooms, stunning ensuite primary suite with a walk-in closet and custom wood shelving. Wainscoting in the living and dining areas adds a warm, inviting feel, while the cozy family room with a fireplace opens seamlessly to the deck for effortless indoor-outdoor living. Additional highlights include LED recessed lighting throughout, laundry conveniently located in the hallway between the bedrooms, copper plumbing, and new epoxy flooring in the front yard, backyard, and garage.
The chef’s kitchen is a true centerpiece, showcasing sleek quartz countertops, new stainless steel appliances, and a clean, modern design ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.
Step outside to fully finished grounds with fresh epoxy in the front yard, backyard, and garage delivering a polished, resort-style feel throughout. A stunning 2-story ADU (approx. 480 sq ft) with soaring ceilings, walls of windows, a beautifully designed kitchen, full bathroom, and a bright loft space, offering the ultimate flexibility for guests, rental income, or a private retreat. Plus, additional potential for a JADU conversion in the garage expands the possibilities even further.
With alley access, copper plumbing, and a thoughtfully placed hallway laundry area, every element blends luxury with practicality.
Located just moments from Ventura Boulevard’s premier dining and shopping and directly across from Trader Joe’s, this property is not just a home… it’s a lifestyle.
